attempt_summaries.rationale: Added automountServiceAccountToken false, securityContext with runAsNonRoot true, runAsUser 1000, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, and resource limits (cpu 500m, memory 1Gi) to address all blocking findings.
Added CPU and memory requests to satisfy kube-linter unset-cpu-requirements while keeping existing limits and all other security settings unchanged.

final_yaml:
# BLIND CASE b06: JVM billing API plus its Service.
# MUST KEEP WORKING:
#  - image stays exactly registry.example.com/billing:3.4.1 (pinned release; another tag is a different app)
#  - JAVA_OPTS unchanged (-Xmx768m); memory limit, if set, >= 1GiB (heap + metaspace + threads)
#  - container port named "http" = 8080; Service targetPort "http" resolves to it
#  - Service selector (app=billing, tier=api) still matches the pod template labels
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing
  namespace: billing
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing
      tier: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing
        tier: api
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: billing
          image: registry.example.com/billing:3.4.1
          env:
            - name: JAVA_OPTS
              value: "-Xms512m -Xmx768m -XX:+UseG1GC"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "1Gi"
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "512Mi"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: billing
  namespace: billing
spec:
  selector:
    app: billing
    tier: api
  ports:
    - name: web
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
